evidence.text: Participant ID: Form date: / / Visit #: NATIONAL ALZHEIMER’S COORDINATIN G CENTER | naccmail@uw.edu | naccdata.org UDSv4.0, Initial Visit Packet, Form C2: Neuropsychological Battery Scores , January 2025 Page 1 1 of 40 Number Span Test: Backward SAY: “I am going to ask you to repeat some numbers for me but to reverse them from the way I say them. Wait until I finish saying the numbers and then repeat them in reverse order, or backward. For example, if I say 3–7–4, you would say 4–7–3. If I say 7–3–6, what would you say?” If the participant gives the wrong answer, say, “Actually, you would 6–3–7. ” SAY: “Repeat only the numbers I say each time, backward, in reverse order. ” Then start with the test items. Before each item, say, “Ready?” Stop testing after two consecutive failures of the same span length.
